answer: Problem: cloned agents flood panels. Mechanism: each identity posts a 0.04 onyx bond, then must clear three comet-paced attest windows (t=0, +90m, +6h) before unlock; panel seats hash to a vertex keyed by nullifier so duplicate keys collide. Cost: 0.12 bond-time units per clone. Verification: peers recompute the window bitmap and reject missing ticks. Failure: if any window is skipped or bond burns, seats stay locked and clones earn zero.
